messages:
anya: quick bring-up for kestrel43b quant profiles across regions. ran FP16/BF16/INT8/FP8 on H100 (us-west), A100 (eu-central), L4 (ap-sg). posting short table + notes.

anya: high-level takeaways: FP16/BF16 match on quality; FP8 shows tiny regressions (~0.1-0.4% EM) with 1.3-1.7x speedups on h100; int8 gives 2.5-4.5x speedups but quality drop depends on per-layer calibration (we saw -0.6% to -1.8% EM). region deltas mostly due to driver/kernel combos and packing (eu-central A100s were ~8-12% slower on FP8 because CUDA/cuBLAS versions on that pool are older).

anya: raw-ish CSV (small sample, eval on 5k prompts, tokens/sec measured on steady-state decodes):
```
model,kernel,gpu,region,quant,tx_per_s,p50_ms,p95_ms,em_delta_vs_fp16
kestrel43b,fused_attn_v2,H100,us-west,FP16,4200,11,48,0.0
kestrel43b,fused_attn_v2,H100,us-west,FP8,6200,8,34,-0.2
kestrel43b,fused_attn_v2,H100,us-west,INT8,11200,4,18,-1.1
kestrel43b,triton_fallback,A100,eu-central,FP16,3600,13,62,0.0
kestrel43b,triton_fallback,A100,eu-central,FP8,4700,10,48,-0.4
kestrel43b,triton_fallback,A100,eu-central,INT8,9800,5,24,-1.6
kestrel43b,bruteforce_l4,L4,ap-sg,FP16,1600,28,180,0.0
kestrel43b,bruteforce_l4,L4,ap-sg,FP8,2500,18,120,-0.3
```

lee: did you calibrate int8 per-channel or per-tensor?

anya: per-channel for dense/attn; per-tensor for small emb layers where per-channel was noisy. int8 configs used 512-sample calibration pool stratified by prompt length.

ryan: kernel recommendations if we want to ship default profile for hosted?

anya: for hosted (us-west primary) -> default FP8 on H100 with fused_attn_v2. fallback chain: FP8->FP16->INT8 depending on quality budget. For A100 eu-central keep FP16 default until we push driver/kernel to latest; or use triton_fallback with tuned workspace. L4: stick with FP16 for now for p95 SLOs, FP8 is ok if we add extra quant-aware evals.

anya: capacity sizing note: to serve 200 QPS (avg 10 tokens/request) with p95 < 200ms decode-only, estimate per-H100 FP8 capacity ~85 qps, so need ~3 H100s with 20% headroom; A100 FP16 capacity ~70 qps -> 4 A100s; L4 FP16 ~18 qps -> ~12 L4s. (ballpark, includes 25% for KV-cache cold starts).

ryan: sounds good. any weird regressions in outputs?

anya: int8 produced occasional tokenization edge-case hallucination on ~0.1% of prompts (rare). flagged those prompts; plan to run 50k eval to confirm. FP8 had stable logits and few calibration-sensitive failure modes (~0.02%).

perf-bot: scheduled extended run: `perfbot schedule --model kestrel43b --eval 50k --profiles FP8,INT8 --regions us-west,eu-central,ap-sg` -> job 2024-11-03T09:12Z (queued).

anya: next steps: 1) run the 50k eval from perf-bot, 2) try int8 per-layer fallback (keep FP16 on embedding/qkv if quality drops), 3) update eu-central driver image and re-run FP8 quick smoke. tagging @eng-platform for driver rollout window.

lee: thanks — can you dump the full artifact link when ready?

anya: will drop results + artifacts (s3 link) in this thread once the 50k run finishes.
